thesis: AMPH has a real uptrend (above SMA20/50/200, +37% over 63 days, rs_63 0.44) backed by accelerating revenue and a cheap valuation (forward P/E 8.9), and health care is among the sectors leading the risk-off tape. But the last close of 29.71 sits above the 28.70-29.50 entry zone, and R/R at that price is only about 1.2 ((32.6-29.71)/(29.71-27.3)), below 1.5. The 32.6 target also needs a clean break of the 31.00 high that was rejected on peak volume on 11/06, while volume is light (vol_ratio 0.91) and QQQ is in a high-confidence risk-off regime. Levels are unchanged from the technical card; entry 29.1 is the zone midpoint. Upgrade to Overweight only if price pulls back into 28.70-29.50 and holds above 27.30, which gives R/R of about 1.9.
invalidation: A daily close below 27.30 (under the 10-day swing low of 27.43 and SMA20 at 27.74) voids the long setup.
key_risks: Target needs a breakout above the 31.00 high that was rejected on 11/06 on peak volume (826k); a target at 31.00 alone gives under 1:1
Price trades above the mean analyst target of 24.5 (recommendationMean 3.14, hold), and the post-earnings catalyst is largely priced in
Short interest is 21.7% of float, so sharp reversals in either direction are possible in a risk-off tape (VIX percentile 0.858)
Weak cash conversion (FCF 9.2M vs 37.8M net income) and total debt of 691.7M vs 230.6M cash
Lumpy earnings (March-quarter net income 6.4M vs 25.3M a year earlier); next earnings date not in the packet
News coverage is thin (a single article in the window)
